subject.title: [Feature Request] Add streamTo="parent" support for runtime="subagent"

question: Should native `runtime="subagent"` support `streamTo="parent"`, and what child progress, tool data, redaction, and routing contract may cross into the parent session or channel?
rationale: Current code safely ignores the ACP-only field, but live native progress changes what isolated child-session data becomes visible to parent users and channel surfaces.

options.title: Design Redacted Native Progress
options.body: Expose bounded lifecycle/progress summaries first, with requester routing, cleanup, timeout, and redaction tests before any tool-result or thinking visibility.

options.title: Keep ACP-Only StreamTo
options.body: Document `streamTo` as permanently ACP-only and leave native subagents on completion events plus `subagents` inspection.

options.title: Build Structured Child Event Stream
options.body: Create a broader subscription surface for native child events, accepting a larger design covering tool output, thinking visibility, and channel limits.

recommendation.title: Design Redacted Native Progress
recommendation.body: Expose bounded lifecycle/progress summaries first, with requester routing, cleanup, timeout, and redaction tests before any tool-result or thinking visibility.

likelyOwner.reason: This crosses current agent/session ownership plus security-sensitive visibility policy, and steipete is the strongest recent current-main routing signal for the relevant files.
